cells.rationale: The threshold equals the latest first print (189,000 for the week ending 2026-10-31, https://www.dol.gov/ui/data.pdf, 2026-11-05), so a repeat fails and a single tick down fails too. But 189,000 was a 5,000 step below the prior 194,000 and 195,000 prints (the 4-week average is 194,750), and the drop came from unadjusted claims falling while the factors expected a rise, a pattern that tends to partly reverse. The factor jumps from 0.933 to 1.036 for the week ending 2026-11-07 (https://www.bls.gov/lau/current-factors.htm), and raw claims rose about 10.5% in the same week of 2025 (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/data/ICNSA); with typical moves of 0 to 5,000, I put roughly 70% on a print of 190,000 or more.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
